svg.title: Identity and access: sign in, bind, grant, revoke

g.text: Identity and access: sign in, bind, grant, revoke
identity: the key is the user
binding: the one signature that gives authorship
authorisation: the creator grants by key
grant (signed by P): Q may write @review
revocation closes the door on arrival
from now, admit nothing new from Q
ops kept on a fork owned by Q;
